stories.title: 5 people, including 2 children, injured in collision on M-57
stories.summary: A westbound Ford Expedition was slowing to turn into the Hilltop Sports complex when it was rear-ended by a Ford Focus. Multiple people were seriously injured.

stories.title: Ottawa Co. Board of Commissioners accepting applications for open District 5 seat following Moss' election to State House
stories.summary: Moss will leave a vacancy in District 5 due to his recent election to represent Michigan's 89th District in the Michigan State House of Representatives.

stories.title: St. Joseph Co. deputies searching for 23-year-old man last seen in July
stories.summary: Deputies say the last contact with Ashton James Coon, 23, was on July 6 in Sturgis. His family is concerned for his welfare.

stories.title: Holland Planning Commission moves forward with plans for Vault Hotel
stories.summary: In a planning commission meeting on Nov. 10, the company Braveworks presented plans on how to transform the downtown Holland bank into a hotel with 42 guest rooms.

stories.title: Additional charges filed against Michigan businesswoman and Democratic donor
stories.summary: Fay Beydoun is accused of using a $20 million state grant for personal use, including allocating $500,000 for her legal defense.

stories.title: Teacher of the Week is tearful and thankful
stories.summary: Teacher Lori Foley was surprised as Teacher of the Week at Mona Shores High School, celebrated for her dedication and emotional commitment to students.

stories.title: Despite court ruling, DOE issues another order for J.H. Campbell Generating Plant to stay open
stories.summary: In September, a U.S. Court of Appeals ruled the DOE's order to keep J.H. Campbell Generator operating as unlawful. The DOE "disagrees" and has issued another order.

stories.title: SUV crash led to foot chase, injury and road closure in Park Township
stories.summary: Deputies arrived at the scene to find a power line fallen across the roadway, multiple signs damaged and a white Acura SUV stopped just past a nearby parking lot.

stories.title: Man shot in foot Saturday night during fight
stories.summary: The man was driven to the hospital where it was determined his condition was not life threatening.

stories.title: Fox Sports' Big Noon Kick Off will come to Ferris State University for first Division II visit
stories.summary: The appointment was announced one day after Ferris State broke an NCAA Division II record for consecutive wins.

stories.title: Ferris State sets new NCAA Division II record after Saturday win over Roosevelt Lakers
stories.summary: The Ferris State Bulldogs now have 41 consecutive wins under their belt, beating the record of 40 previously set by Grand Valley State University.

stories.title: 2 dead, 1 injured in Mount Pleasant shooting
stories.summary: Police responded to a reported shooting in Mt. Pleasant and found two people deceased and one person seriously injured. There is no immediate threat to the public.
